origin.description: Second-difference matrix, formed by differencing the gradient.

arguments.name: f
arguments.text: Function returning one value or a vector of values.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Point at which the Hessian is estimated.

arguments.name: centered
arguments.text: Passed to the perturbed gradient calls. The reference gradient stays a forward difference.

arguments.name: pert
arguments.text: Step used to difference the gradients. It is not passed into gradient.

origin.details: The reference gradient uses gradient's defaults. Each perturbed call receives centered and not pert. The gradient matrix is written into a column in column-major order, so a vector-valued function produces one block per variable.
origin.value: A matrix with one column per variable.
origin.example:
f <- function(x) sum(x^2)
x <- c(a = 1, b = -3)
hessian(f, x)
